preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 4 and 1000.
The maximum allowed number of roads k must be between n-1 and 2n-2.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n and len({a, b, c, d}) == 4
preconditions.description: Cities a, b, c, and d must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(v) == n and len(u) == n and v[0] == a and v[-1] == b and u[0] == c and u[-1] == d)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must contain two paths of length n starting and ending at the specified cities.

postconditions.expression: len(set((v[i], v[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)) | set((u[i], u[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))) <= k
postconditions.description: The total number of distinct roads used in both paths must not exceed k.
